readerNotes.line: Traced the heavy ticked line from the top edge north of Geilenkirchen, around the Roer and Monschau, around the Bulge (Stavelot, north face to Hotton and Rochefort, down the doubled line to St Hubert, around the Bastogne corridor) then east along the Sure and south down the Moselle and Saar to the east edge. The stretch from Rochefort south to St Hubert is drawn as a doubled wavy line, read as front. Below the east exit a thin line runs south to Faulquemont, read as a boundary not the front.
